2026-10-16

- Adopt idempotent retries using a client-sent dedupe key (Option A); do not build the server-side dedupe table (Option B).. Why: Option B would incorrectly block two legitimate payments of the same amount within the time window (Mira's concern).
- Theo will update the reconciliation job to read the dedupe key.

results.body_markdown:
**Team adopts client-side idempotent retries (dedupe key) for payment requests; server dedupe table dropped**

**Highlights**
- Decision locked in: Option A (client sends a dedupe key; gateway rejects duplicates for 24 h). No server-side dedupe table will be built.
- Gateway already supports the idempotency-key header, so no gateway-side changes are required.
- Rollout sequence agreed: web client first, then the mobile client in the release after next.
- Reconciliation job will be updated to read the dedupe key (Theo).

**Risks**
- All four clients must be modified to send the dedupe key; the mobile client ships on a two-week release cadence, constraining rollout timing.
- Duplicate charges will continue until the mobile client release ships.
- Option B (server dedupe table) was rejected because it could block legitimate same-amount payments within the window — a correctness risk with money.

**Next steps**
- Jun to write the ADR documenting the idempotent-retry decision by Wednesday.
- Mira to own and publish the rollout plan (web → mobile).
- Theo to update the reconciliation job to consume the dedupe key.
- Speaker to draft a stakeholder/support-team update noting that duplicate charges will stop after the mobile release.
